identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study to Investigate ALE.P03 as Monotherapy in Adult Patients With Selected Advanced or Metastatic CLDN1+ Solid Tumors
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase I/II, Open-label, Multicenter Study of ALE.P03 (Claudin-1 Targeted Antibody-drug Conjugate) as a Monotherapy in Adult Patients With Selected Advanced or Metastatic CLDN1+ Solid Tumors

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetic, pharmacodynamic, preliminary anti-tumor activity, and to determine the recommended Phase II dose (RP2D) of the ALE.P03 monotherapy in adult patients with selected squamous solid tumors.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: This Study has a Phase I ALE.P03 monotherapy dose escalation and recommended dose for expansion (RDE) study and a Phase II study of ALE.P03 as monotherapy at RP2D in adult patients with selected advanced or metastatic Claudin-1 positive (CLDN1+) cancers.

designInfo.interventionModelDescription: For Phase I recommended dose for expansion (RDE) part of the study, patients will be randomized in 1:1 ratio to identify the recommended Phase II dose (RP2D) for Phase II.

armGroups.label: Phase I Dose Escalation- ALE.P03
armGroups.description: Patients will receive ALE.P03 as monotherapy via intravenous infusion. The ALE.P03 will be given at an escalated dose until Maximum tolerated dose (MTD) and/or a safe recommended dose for expansion (RDE) is determined in Phase I dose escalation part of the study.

armGroups.label: Phase I Dose Expansion- ALE.P03
armGroups.description: Patients will receive ALE.P03 as monotherapy via intravenous infusion. The safe recommended doses of ALE.P03 will be given in Phase I dose expansion part of the study to identify recommended Phase II dose (RP2D) for Phase II.

armGroups.label: Phase II- ALE.P03
armGroups.description: Patients will receive ALE.P03 as monotherapy via intravenous infusion at the RP2D, or according to the dosing schedule after the dose expansion phase.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Number of Patients with Dose Limiting Toxicities (DLTs) (Phase I)
primaryOutcomes.description: DLTs as defined in the protocol will be assessed to evaluate safety and tolerability of ALE.P03 (Phase I Dose Escalation), and to establish RP2D for ALE.P03 (Phase I RDE).

primaryOutcomes.measure: Number of Patients with Adverse Events (Phase I)
primaryOutcomes.description: Adverse events will be assessed to evaluate safety and tolerability of ALE.P03 (Phase I Dose Escalation), and to establish RP2D for ALE.P03 (Phase I RDE).
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From Day 1 up to Safety follow-up (30 ± 5 days post last dose [Up to 4 years])

primaryOutcomes.description: The ORR is the proportion of patients with a best overall response (BOR) of complete response (CR) or partial response (PR) according to Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST 1.1.) This is assessed to establish RP2D for ALE.P03 (Phase I RDE)
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From ALE.P03 treatment initiation until at or prior to initiation of the use of new anti-cancer therapy (Up to 4 years)

primaryOutcomes.description: The DoR is defined for patients achieving a CR or PR as per Investigator review according to RECIST 1.1 to disease progression before new anti-cancer therapy or death of any cause, whichever occurs earlier. This is assessed to establish RP2D for ALE.P03 (Phase I RDE).
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From ALE.P03 treatment initiation until disease progression or study completion (Up to 4 years)

primaryOutcomes.description: The ORR is assessed to assess anti-tumor activity of ALE.P03 (Phase II).
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From ALE.P03 treatment initiation until at or prior to initiation of the use of new anti-cancer therapy (Up to 4 years)

primaryOutcomes.description: The DoR is defined for patients achieving a confirmed CR or PR as the time from the initial response of CR or PR to disease progression before new anti-cancer therapy or death of any cause, whichever occurs earlier. This is assessed to assess anti-tumor activity of ALE.P03 (Phase II).
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From ALE.P03 treatment initiation until disease progression or study completion (Up to 4 years)

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Number of Patients with Adverse Events (Phase I RDE and Phase II)
secondaryOutcomes.description: Adverse events will be assessed to evaluate safety and tolerability of ALE.P03 (Phase I RDE and Phase II)
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From Day 1 up to Safety follow-up (30 ± 5 days post last dose [Up to 4 years]

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Disease control rate (DCR) (Phase I and II)
secondaryOutcomes.description: The DCR is defined as the proportion of patients with a BOR of CR or PR or stable disease (SD) per Investigator review according to RECIST 1.1 at or prior to initiation of the use of new anti-cancer therapy. This is assessed to evaluate preliminary evidence of anti-tumor activity of ALE.P03 (Phase I and II).
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From ALE.P03 treatment initiation until at or prior to initiation of the use of new anti-cancer therapy (Up to 4 years)

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Median Progression-Free Survival (PFS) rate at 6 and 12 Months (Phase I and II)
secondaryOutcomes.description: The PFS is defined as time from first study treatment to a documented disease progression according to RECIST 1.1, as determined by the Investigator, or death due to any cause, whichever occurs earlier. This is assessed to evaluate preliminary evidence of anti-tumor activity of ALE.P03 (Phase I and II).
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: At 6 and 12 months after initiation of ALE.P03 treatment

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Median Overall Survival (OS) rate at 6, 12, and 24 Months (Phase I and II)
secondaryOutcomes.description: The OS is defined as time from first study treatment to death due to any cause. This is assessed to evaluate preliminary evidence of anti-tumor activity of ALE.P03 (Phase I and II).
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: At 6, 12, and 24 months after initiation of ALE.P03 treatment

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Blood Concentration of ALE.P03 Antibody-drug Conjugate (ADC) (Phase I and II)
secondaryOutcomes.description: Concentrations of ALE.P03 ADC in blood will be measured at each scheduled time point per arms.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Phase I and II: From Day 1 until at end of treatment visit (EoT) (Up to 4 years)

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Blood Concentrations of Total Antibody (Phase I and II)

secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Phase I and II: From Day 1 until at EoT (Up to 4 years)

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Blood Concentrations of Payload (Phase I and II)

secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Phase I and II: From Day 1 until at EoT (Up to 4 years)

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Area under the concentration-time curve over the dosing interval (AUCtau) (Phase I and II)
secondaryOutcomes.description: The AUCtau of ALE.P03 will be measured to assess the pharmacokinetic (PK) profile of ALE.P03.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Phase I and II: From Day 1 until at EoT (Up to 4 years)

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Area under the concentration-time curve from pre-dose (time 0) to the time of the last quantifiable concentration (AUClast) (Phase I and II)

secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Phase I and II: From Day 1 until at EoT (Up to 4 years)

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Time of Maximum Concentration (tmax) (Phase I and II)
secondaryOutcomes.description: The tmax of ALE.P03 will be measured to assess the PK profile of ALE.P03. It is determined directly from the concentration-time profile.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Phase I and II: From Day 1 until at EoT (Up to 4 years)

secondaryOutcomes.description: The Cavg of ALE.P03 will be measured to assess the PK profile of ALE.P03.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Phase I and II: From Day 1 until at EoT (Up to 4 years)

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Number of Patients with Presence of anti-ALE.P03 Antibodies (Phase I and II)
secondaryOutcomes.description: Presence of anti-ALE.P03 Antibodies will be assessed to evaluate the immunogenicity of ALE.P03.

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Have histologically and cytologically metastatic confirmed advanced or metastatic colorectal cancer, intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma, squamous non-small cell lung cancer, urothelial carcinoma, and cervical squamous cell carcinoma.
* Have documented radiological disease progression at study entry.
* Have provided tissue for CLDN1 (Claudin-1) analysis in a central laboratory.

Phase I Dose Escalation:

\- Received and being refractory/intolerant to available systemic standard of care (SOC) regimens (based on local institutional guidelines) for advanced disease.

Phase I RDE and Phase II:

* Received 1-2 available systemic SOC regimens (based on local institutional guidelines) for advanced disease and being refractory or intolerant to treatment.
* Patients with actionable oncogenic drivers: received feasible targeted therapy.

Applicable for Phase I Dose Escalation, Phase I RDE and Phase II:

* Measurable disease per RECIST 1.1, as determined by the site.
* Have a performance status of 0 or 1 on the Eastern Cooperative Oncology Groups Performance Status.
* Demonstrate adequate bone marrow and organ function as per the protocol.

Exclusion Criteria:

* SqNSCLC and CSCC: diagnosed with a tumor of predominantly non-squamous histology result or adenocarcinoma.
* Has received antineoplastic therapies prior to study intervention within specified time frame.
* Has rapidly progressing disease.
* Has known active central nervous system metastases and/or carcinomatous meningitis.
* Has a history of (non-infectious) interstitial lung disease/pneumonitis that required steroids or current symptomatic or clinically significant pneumonitis requiring steroids and/or immunosuppressive therapies.
* Has clinically significant gastrointestinal bleeding.
* Has an active infection requiring systemic treatment.
* Has a history or current evidence of any condition, therapy, or laboratory abnormality that might confound the results of the clinical study.
